concepts.definition: the smallest structural and functional unit of a living organism
a group of similar cells working together to perform a particular function
a structure made of different tissues that cooperate to perform a specific function
the process by which green plants use light energy to make glucose from carbon dioxide and water
the cellular process that releases usable energy from food molecules
the net movement of water through a selectively permeable membrane from higher to lower water potential
the net movement of particles from a region of higher concentration to a region of lower concentration
a community of organisms interacting with one another and with their physical environment
the study of heredity and variation in living organisms
the maintenance of a relatively stable internal environment despite external changes
